item.description: Republican Gov. Phil Scott won a sixth term as Vermont governor. He defeated Democrat Amanda Janoo by six points with most votes counted. Vermont voters also approved two constitutional amendments on labor and equal rights.

A new Vermont State Police barracks is planned in Clarendon near Route one hundred three and Route seven. The project does not require an Act two hundred fifty permit. The new facility is expected to be completed in twenty twenty-seven.
A child in Lewis County New York died from measles, the state's first such death in over thirty years. Health officials urge residents to keep up with MMR vaccinations.

Linda McCuen of Proctor High School is Vermont's Teacher of the Year for twenty-twenty-seven. She has taught in Vermont for twenty-three years. McCuen will serve as an ambassador for educators statewide starting in January.
